{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|It's a pity that you were not here last month for the Flamewind, which was spectacular this year.|The manager of the [[Oseon Resort]]|<ref name="mf">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
The '''Flamewind of Oseon''', also called simply the '''Flamewind''', was a unique [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] storm that, once a year, bathed the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] in bright, shifting colors and served as a major tourist attraction. The Flamewind caused significant interference on electronic systems, forcing those in the system to stay in place for the duration of the three-week phenomenon, which was observed with constant revelry from Oseon natives and visitors alike. The storm also had unique hallucinatory effects on onlookers, especially those passing through the storm on [[Starship/Legends|starships]], that could even be observed in [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==Description==
{{Quote|During Flamewind, there's no way of accurately estimating drift, and&mdash;|[[Vuffi Raa]]|<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>}}
Noted for its wild, shifting [[Color/Legends|colors]], the "Flamewind" was the name given to a spatial irregularity that passed through the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality's]] [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] annually, cutting off the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to all outside trade and communications. The Flamewind manifested as an unpredictable [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] storm that filled [[Realspace/Legends|space]] with all kinds of vibrant colors&mdash;picturesque to watch from one of the Oseon's [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], but highly dangerous to traverse in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The increased radiation noise from the phenomenon was known to accelerate electronic decay and scramble [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and gauges, requiring [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to fly by the seat of their pants through a hazardous [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].<ref name="gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref>

The Flamewind was known to be overwhelming to direct observers, especially those viewing the radiation storm for the first time, and those caught directly in its fury could suffer symptoms such as vomiting and loss of hair and skin.<ref name="LCFO" /> The Flamewind also appeared to have hallucinatory effects on [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]&mdash;<ref name="gamer5" />and even some [[Droid/Legends|droids]]&mdash;<ref name="LCFO" />that observed the phenomenon, while also causing mood shifts corresponding with different colors. The exact cause of the Flamewind was unknown as of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], though some scientists speculated that it had something to do with [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]].<ref name="gamer5" />

==History==
{{Quote|As you probably are aware, it is perilous in the extreme, and also illegal, for ships to travel from asteroid to asteroid in the Oseon during Flamewind.|[[Lob Doluff]]|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
Although the Oseon had hosted populations of [[Mining/Legends|miners]] for some time, the unique Flamewind phenomenon did not become widely known until the system was visited by former [[Circus/Legends|circus]] ringleader and [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Gadfrey Oseon]], who once found himself trapped in the system for three weeks while refueling his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on an asteroid. Oseon decided to stay after coming up with the idea to put a luxury [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] and [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in the asteroid belt, where guests could come to observe the Flamewind and [[Gambling/Legends|gamble]] away their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in the meantime. Oseon's dream helped turn the system that would take his name into one of the wealthiest in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the Flamewind into an in-demand tourist attraction that attracted crowds of all [[Species/Legends|species]] to the system to revel for weeks underneath the shifting lights.<ref name="gamer5" />

As a new economy began to grow up around Flamewind, measures were taken to protect the system's denizens and visitors, as all commerce and travel between the Oseon's asteroids was legally banned during the phenomenon. However, some daring [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] used Flamewind as cover to run illegal goods such as the banned narcotic ''[[Lesai/Legends|lesai]]''&mdash;in one case, gambler [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] survived a treacherous journey from [[Oseon 6845]] to [[Oseon 5792]] at the height of Flamewind in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. With so many people in confined spaces over the course of the three-week celebration, a noticeable jump in the Oseon's [[Human/Legends|Human]] birthrate was routinely observed nine months after Flamewind.<ref name="LCFO" /> It also began to take on its own mythology&mdash;observers told stories that the phenomenon was actually a legion of ghosts, a soul-train belonging to a long-extinct [[Species/Legends|species]], or that the Flamewind itself had transmitted messages to people and sent them on missions throughout the galaxy.<ref name="gamer5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Flamewind appears in, and is the namesake of, ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', written by [[L. Neil Smith]] and released in [[1983]].<ref name="LCFO" />
